title: [Master]-Purchase Credit Memo – "Get Return Shipment Lines" fails for Non-Inventory items with "corrective credit memo can only reverse the original posted invoice" error (regression from Bug 636861)
summary: Purchase credit memos can now retrieve return shipment lines for non-inventory items without triggering an error about corrective credit memos, fixing a regression.
key_points: Resolves a failure when using 'Get Return Shipment Lines' for non-inventory items on purchase credit memos
Removes an erroneous validation that incorrectly prevented corrective credit memos from reversing certain invoice lines
Updates Purchase Line logic across multiple localization layers
Includes test coverage for the corrected behavior
